title: A late lease release of turn N does not free the lease turn N+1 renewed
steps: S1: turn N writes, turn N+1 writes, N's release arrives.
expect: S1: lease still held by N+1; another chat is refused.
S2: the highest turn is kept.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: release freed by session only; a slow release could free the next turn's lease mid-request
fence: Release compares the turn in the same UPDATE

tests: a late release of turn N leaves the hold turn N+1 renewed
writes landing out of order keep the highest turn
a release with no turn, or of a lease that recorded none, behaves as before
